fact: The minister of digital development said a $55 million subsidy initiative under the World Bank DECIM project, launched that day, will fund rural towers, fibre and network expansion, alongside a universal service fund fed by about 2% of operator revenue and a pilot of 73 RuralStar pylons in Menabe.
title: Interview with Hon. Stéphanie Delmotte Minister of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications of Madagascar (MNDPT)
